hints.title: Bitwise OR Monotonicity
hints.text: For a fixed starting index i, as the subarray extends rightward, the cumulative bitwise or can change at most 30 times.

hints.title: Latest Bit Occurrence Tracking
hints.text: Iterate from right to left while recording the nearest index where each bit (from 0 to 29) is set.

hints.title: Subarray Reach Calculation
hints.text: At index i, the maximum possible bitwise or will include all bits available from index i onwards. The shortest subarray must extend to max(i, max_over_set_bits(last_idx[b])).

hints.title: Reverse Bit Position Tracking Implementation

complexity.notes: Single reverse pass evaluating 30 bits per index.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all subarray OR values starting at each index takes O(n^2) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Array of 30 integers tracks the most recent occurrence of each bit position.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that each bit needs to be satisfied by its nearest subsequent occurrence.
